violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: commercially prepared hummus in the Randell 2-door salad/sandwich unit was 50º. Yogurt and sour cream in the unit was 43º.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Both products were discarded.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: a container of mashed potatoes on the hot rail was 125°F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The PIC had the potatoes reheated to 165°F to correct during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed frozen vacuum, packed salmon being thawed improperly. The packaging was still intact after thawing.
violations.corrective_action: Frozen vacuum packed fish must be cut open when thawing to prevent the growth of anaerobic bacteria. The EHS explain this to the PIC and staff who said they will remove the salmon from the packages before thawing from now on.

violations.title: Food Thermometers Accuracy, Only Degrees F
violations.observation: The thermometer inside one of the prep unit was not accurate and needed to be replaced
violations.corrective_action: Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to +/- 2 degrees F in the intended range of use. The PIC replaced the thermometer during the inspection. CDI.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. There were not paper towels at the handsink in the dish machine area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. The manager corrected this during the inspection. CDI.

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. There was no hand soap at the handsink in the dish machine room.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. The manager refilled the dispenser during the inspection.

violations.title: Handwashing Signage
violations.observation: Observed that sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands is not provided or is not clearly visible at all handwashing sinks used by food employees. There was no “employees must wash hands” in one of employee only restrooms.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a visible sign or poster at all handwashing sinks used by food employees that reminds food employees to wash their hands. Please install a sign as soon as possible or within 6 months.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: mashed potatoes in one of the hot holding units were 106ºF.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. The manager had the mashed potatoes reheated to 165º during the inspection.

violations.title: Non-TCS Food Contact Surface, Clean per Manufacturer
violations.observation: Surfaces of ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment are not being cleaned as required. A replaceable part in the ice machine was visibly stained.
violations.corrective_action: Surfaces of utensils and equipment contacting food that is NOT time/temperature control for safety food such as ice bins, beverage dispensing nozzles, and enclosed components of equipment such as ice makers, cooking oil storage tanks and distribution lines, beverage and syrup dispensing lines or tubes, coffee bean grinders, and water vending equipment at a frequency specified by the manufacturer or at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil or mold. The manager stated he has already submitted a work request to replace this part with a new one. Replace before the next routine inspection.
